findings.text: follow-on: the no-document branch returns a 5-column cell where every document-bearing row returns 27, so the reason cell that follows starts 22 columns earlier for a backend without a lane document; the fixed-column design the module states at ticker.py:737-744 is kept across the mean and clause states but not across the no-clause one, and no test binds the lane cell to one width.

follow-on: the no-clause test asserts LANE_LABEL ('lane') is absent from the whole rendered row, so it would false-fail the day any other column's text (node, reason) contains that substring; asserting the lane cell directly, or that the row carries no LANE_MEAN_UNPUBLISHED/LANE_DOC_STALE clause, would bind the same behaviour without depending on unrelated columns.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit: fd0ad2b1e replaces LANE_MEAN_UNAVAILABLE with LANE_MEAN_UNPUBLISHED/LANE_DOC_STALE and a per-cause return, 47e430875 only reorders the new test's imports, d6900b355 adds the evidence fragment alone.
item_verdicts.done_when: the four cases render through Ticker.render and each of tests/test_lane_cell_names_its_cause.py's four tests asserts its clause plus a literal 'unavailable' guard; I re-ran that file with tests/test_ticker_shows_the_lane_mean.py at head and read 16 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node makes the lane cell name why it holds no mean instead of a phrase read as an outage; reckon/crew/ticker.py:805 lane_mean_from_text and ticker.py:1469 _lane_cells return the no-document case with no lane clause, the no-throughput case as LANE_MEAN_UNPUBLISHED, the stale case as LANE_DOC_STALE, and a real mean as before.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete; baseline_suite at cee50d7f4 (38 failed/373 passed, completed true) and after_suite at d6900b355 (29 failed/382 passed, completed true) are recorded with literal commands and log paths, and added_failure_ids is empty.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff spans exactly docs/evidence/fragments/crew-observability-truth/lane-cell-names-its-cause.html, reckon/crew/ticker.py, tests/test_lane_cell_names_its_cause.py and tests/test_ticker_shows_the_lane_mean.py, which equal the manifest's declared write paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_lane_cell_names_its_cause.py:62's assert_no_outage_wording uses an independent literal, and the negative-control mutation that reapplied an 'unavailable' clause word reddened it; docked because the clause-presence assertions compare the output against the same module constant the code interpolates, so only the wording guard is independent of the implementation.
justifications.evidence: both arms are recorded at their own revisions with completed true and literal commands, head-arm.log names revision d6900b3556 (the reviewed head), and the negative control ends EXIT=1 with a failing id absent from the head arm; docked because the base arm's tree carried the new test file that cee50d7f4 does not contain, so its three lane-cause failures are the reproduction rather than a clean base arm, and two session_delivery ids differ between arms as a load flake.
justifications.fit: constants are named by mechanism and the dead LANE_MEAN_UNAVAILABLE is removed cleanly at reckon/crew/ticker.py:737; docked because the no-document branch shrinks the lane cell, letting the trailing reason column start at a different offset for a codex-shaped row than for a document-bearing one in the same pane.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reconcile/crew/ticker.py:1492-1499 -- the no-document backend returns the bare rate with no clause, a declared-but-unread document returns LANE_MEAN_UNPUBLISHED, a stale one LANE_DOC_STALE, and a mean as before; docked one because the no-document cell is 5 columns wide against 27 for every document-bearing row and no test binds the lane cell to one width.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat cee50d7f4..d6900b355 touches only the four declared paths and the third commit is docs-only, with no plan or shared index mutated.
